title: OK LED Smart Strip Light Set at a Reasonable Price
text:
OK LED Smart Strip Light Set at a Reasonable Price. I have been using SmartHome products for more than 10 years, very close to when they started being produced and widely used. A few years later, I began testing, reviewing and writing about these products for several non biased comparison sites. Due to the experience within this particular area I have a broad base of knowledge within the Smart Lighting arena.

There are several considerations that need to be taken into account when choosing the appropriate Smart Light for a particular situation.

I have tested and written about literally dozens of LED strip lights over the last 10 years. I have tracked the advancements in the technology, understand the most likely areas of product failure and what separates the best LED strip lighting from the others.

In terms of light output, strip lights, of which this review focuses, is typically used for ambient or mood lighting rather than light to work or read by. Similar to the Hue Smart Strip Light, and frankly most major branded strip lights, this BIHRTC Light Strip can only produce one color at a time. In comparison, the LIFX Z Light Strip has 8 distinct controllable zones in every meter of light strip which allows for rainbow colors, animation effects and a full host of special effects.

The materials this BIHRTC Light Strip is constructed from are pretty standard in quality. The rubber covering the LED bulbs is thick yet very flexible. The 3M adhesive tape is standard on these smart light strips although people regularly have issues with them sticking.

The best advice I have as to getting any light strip to stay is to first thoroughly clean the surface the light is going to be attached upon. I first clean with a typical cleaning product such as a Lysol wipe, then thoroughly dry and then clean with an alcohol pad. Personally I don’t use the 3M double sided tape to hang the lights as it’s so prone to coming loose. I recommend the Gorilla Glue double sided tape which will be guaranteed to hold your lights where intended until you move them.

In comparison to other Smart LED Light strips this BIHRTC strip light is lower in lumen output to the Hue Smart Light Strip sets. While the colors are significantly less vibrant when compared to the Hue.

When comparing the duoco strip App (the actual name of the app used to control these lights) to the Phillips Hue App - the Phillips Hue app is much more robust and easier to use. When considering either of these two smart LED light strips to the LIFX Z, I have found the LIFX Z has the best colors, most versatility and best app - but it is also by far the most expensive.

In terms of the duoco strip App I had no issue connecting to the light via Bluetooth, due to it connecting via Bluetooth and not WiFi, range will be far more limited in terms of controlling, but this is rarely an issue. The app has plenty of pre programmed lighting modes, allows for syncing to music and custom colorization. Due to this being a product specific app I have yet to find a way to integrate it with my SmartThings hub.

A huge bonus to this BIHRTC LED Strip Light set that is rarely seen is the ability to control it with a connected control module. Consisting of only 3 buttons it allows the lights to be turned on, change colors and switch between modes. The set also comes with an IR remote that allows for greater control and, of course, the app which allows for even more.

This product, BIHRTC LED Strip Lights is decent quality - especially at this price point. The other sets I compared it with cost approximately 4-6 times as much - I chose those as they are the ones people are most familiar with.

In terms of value and functionality this is decent LED Strip Light Set that I recommend if you are not looking to integrate with other SmartHome products.
